thread:
zoe: hi all — i'm a short-term contractor starting Monday. couple of constraints: 1) i can't accept international shipments to my city, 2) customer's environment is air-gapped so no personal device enrollment, 3) my company requires a background check which isn't done yet. what are our options for MFA and phishsim?
mia-it: welcome Zoe! for air-gapped projects we usually provision an on-prem kiosk or a locked loaner in the customer's office. if you can't get a physical key shipped we can do a partner-issued smartcard pickup at their local office. which city are you in?
zoe: i'm in Hangzhou. vendor partner has a small office there but i won't be allowed to collect on behalf of the company without ID.
contractor-admin: we can create a scoped contractor account with JIT (just-in-time) credentials and a strict TTL while background check is pending. access will be limited to non-PI datasets until clearance. MFA is mandatory — options: onsite smartcard, local partner YubiKey pickup, or temporary cert tied to the kiosk.
security: tagging from security. Important: phishsim inclusion must be coordinated — contractors on short engagements are usually excluded by default until background checks complete, but HR must record the exemption. Also we need a signed Data Sensitivity Addendum (DSA) before granting any access to customer data.
hr: @zoe please fill the contractor packet and DSA: https://redwood.example/hr/contractor-packet. For phishsim opt-out, check the box and upload any required vetting docs. Processing window 48 business hours after submission.
zoe: filed packet and DSA, attached the authorized partner contact for local pickup. background check is in progress but not cleared.
mia-it: thanks. logistics-bot: can you reserve a loaner kiosk at the partner office for the first 14 days and set a ticket for on-site credentialing?
logistics-bot: reservation created: RES-11872. Kiosk reserved 2026-04-06 to 2026-04-20 at Partner Hangzhou Office. Delivery and pickup handled by local partner.
contractor-admin: creating the JIT account now with minimal privileges. it'll expire in 7 days by default. If background check clears, we'll extend and convert to a full contractor account.
security: reminder: no software installs on the kiosk except vetted connector; no USB mass storage; we enable USB HID for the smartcard only. Also disable clipboard and external sharing.
zoe: that's fine. one more: can i be excluded from phishing simulations until my role starts? those exercises cause anxiety.
hr: noted — we will mark phishsim opt-out in your HR record while the DSA and background check are pending. Security will apply the exclusion after HR records it. Expect ~48 business hours.
mia-it: once you use the kiosk, we'll enroll the hardware credential into Okta and test SSO. I'll DM step-by-step for the partner check-in.
contractor-admin: also adding a minimal audit hook: we will record kiosk sessions for the engagement and provide logs to customer on request.
zoe: appreciate it, thank you. DMing my partner contact and will confirm times.
security: final note: if at any point you need access to email or shared drives, file a narrow access request and list exact resources; default is deny.
zoe: understood. thanks everyone!
